title: First-Class Functions: Anonymous fun Closures & fun Mod:Fun/Arity Captures
solutionExplanation: Demonstrates anonymous closures capturing lexical variables, unary function guards with is_function/2, remote function capture, and strategy factory patterns.

otpDocCards.description: First-class lexical closure capturing enclosing scope variables into process heap environment.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(1) allocation of environment vector on process heap.

otpDocCards.description: Guard BIF returning true if Term is a function expecting exactly Arity arguments.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(1) BIF header tag and arity check.

mentalModelCheck.question: What is the primary operational difference between fun(X) -> erlang:abs(X) end and fun erlang:abs/1?

options.label: The remote capture fun erlang:abs/1 resolves dynamically through the module export table, supporting hot code reloading and avoiding an extra function call frame
options.explanation: Remote captures dynamically dispatch to the latest version of the module and avoid redundant lambda wrapper allocations.

options.label: The capture fun erlang:abs/1 runs synchronously in C while the lambda runs in Erlang bytecode
options.explanation: Both execute the underlying BIF; the difference lies in dispatch mechanism and closure environment allocation.

options.label: Only the lambda can accept negative integers
options.explanation: Both accept all numeric terms valid for erlang:abs/1.
